BREVANO ESPRESSO SYSTEMS — CONSUMER SERVICE CENTRE
WARRANTY DETERMINATION PACKET, SERVICE ORDER SO-26-118374

DOCUMENT 1 — LIMITED WARRANTY FOR HOME MACHINES, FORM WB-HOME-22 (APPLIES TO PURCHASES FROM 1 JANUARY 2022)

1. Who gives this warranty
This warranty is given by Brevano Espresso Systems ("Brevano") to the first end-user purchaser of a new Brevano home espresso machine bought from Brevano or from an authorised retailer listed in Annex A. It is in addition to, and does not limit, your statutory rights against the seller.

2. Definitions
2.1 "Purchase Date" — the date shown on the original proof of purchase (receipt or invoice). If a machine was delivered later than it was paid for, the delivery date shown on the delivery note is used instead.
2.2 "Registration" — completion of the online product registration at brevano-example.com/register (or by phone to the service centre) with the machine's serial number and Purchase Date. The registration date is the date on which the registration is recorded in Brevano's system.
2.3 "Commercial Use" — use of the machine (a) in a café, bar, restaurant, hotel, shop or similar establishment, (b) in an office or workplace used by more than 10 people, or (c) to prepare drinks that are sold or otherwise supplied in return for payment. Use in a private household, including a home office used by the householder, is not Commercial Use.
2.4 "Parts" — replacement components supplied by Brevano. "Labour" — the technician's time for diagnosis, disassembly, repair and testing, charged at the flat rates in Annex B.
2.5 "Wear Items" — gaskets, shower screens, filter baskets, water filter cartridges, drip trays and cups.

3. What is covered and for how long
3.1 Standard coverage: for 24 months from the Purchase Date, Brevano will repair any defect in materials or workmanship free of charge for Parts and Labour.
3.2 Extended parts coverage: if the machine was registered within 30 days of the Purchase Date, Brevano will additionally supply Parts free of charge for defects arising in months 25 to 36 after the Purchase Date. Labour in this period is charged to the customer at the flat rates in Annex B.
3.3 Commercial Use: if the machine has been used for Commercial Use at any time, the coverage period in 3.1 is 12 months and 3.2 does not apply.
3.4 Replacement: if Brevano determines that a covered defect cannot be repaired, or that the repair cost would exceed 70% of the current retail price of an equivalent machine, Brevano will instead provide a replacement credit. During the standard coverage period the credit is 100% of the original purchase price; during extended parts coverage it is reduced by 1/36 of the purchase price for each full month since the Purchase Date.
3.5 Repairs and replacement parts do not extend the warranty period.

4. What is not covered
4.1 Wear Items (except when defective on delivery).
4.2 Damage caused by limescale where the machine has not been descaled as instructed in the user manual. Where the machine's descaling log shows descaling at the recommended intervals, limescale is not grounds for refusal.
4.3 Accidental damage, misuse, use of non-Brevano parts, repairs by unauthorised persons, use on incorrect voltage.
4.4 Cosmetic damage not affecting function.
4.5 Machines purchased from sellers not listed in Annex A (including grey imports and marketplace sellers), unless the machine was sold new with a Brevano-issued warranty card stamped by the seller.

5. How to claim
5.1 Contact the service centre with your proof of purchase and serial number. You will receive a service order and a prepaid shipping label or a technician appointment.
5.2 Diagnosis is free if the claim is covered. If the claim is not covered, or if Labour is chargeable under 3.2, a quote will be sent before any work is carried out.

ANNEX A — AUTHORISED RETAILERS (EXTRACT, VALID 2024–2026)
Casa Crema Stores; Kaffeehaus Direkt GmbH; Rösterei Nord & Söhne (online and shops); ElectroPlanet (all branches); Brevano Online Shop.
Not authorised (known grey-market sellers, for staff information): Kaffeehaus Discount24; BestBuyCoffee Outlet; any marketplace seller not listed above.

ANNEX B — FLAT LABOUR RATES (FROM 1 JANUARY 2026)
Diagnosis EUR 45; pump replacement EUR 85; boiler replacement EUR 140; brew group service EUR 60; electronics board replacement EUR 70.

DOCUMENT 2 — SERVICE BULLETIN SB-2024-07 (ISSUED 25 SEPTEMBER 2024)
Subject: Registration portal outage and extended registration window
Between 1 August and 20 September 2024 the product registration portal was intermittently unavailable and many phone registrations could not be completed. To ensure customers are not disadvantaged, for machines with a Purchase Date between 1 July 2024 and 30 September 2024 inclusive, a registration recorded within 60 days of the Purchase Date is treated as a registration within 30 days for the purposes of clause 3.2 of WB-HOME-22. All other terms remain unchanged. This bulletin does not change the length of standard coverage.

DOCUMENT 3 — SERVICE BULLETIN SB-2025-02 (ISSUED 3 MARCH 2025)
Subject: Pump supplier change
From serial number range BH-6-25xxxxx onward, the vibratory pump is sourced from a new supplier. Pumps from the previous supplier remain fully supported; replacement pumps for older machines are the new part number P-4410-B. No change to warranty terms.

DOCUMENT 3A — SERVICE CENTRE OPERATING NOTES (INTERNAL)
- Shipping: prepaid labels are issued for all warranty claims, including claims where Labour will be charged. Machines must be emptied of water and beans and shipped in the original box or the loan box supplied by Brevano.
- Loan machines: offered only during standard coverage (months 1–24) or where the repair takes longer than 10 business days.
- Quotes: any chargeable amount must be quoted to the customer in writing and accepted before work starts. Unaccepted quotes expire after 14 days, and the machine is returned unrepaired at no charge for return shipping.
- Goodwill: team leaders may approve goodwill of up to EUR 50 per case for customer-experience reasons. Goodwill is recorded separately and does not change the warranty determination recorded in the system.
- Recording: the warranty determination field has four values — "Full warranty", "Parts only", "Replacement credit", "Not covered".

DOCUMENT 4 — CUSTOMER AND MACHINE RECORD
Customer: Ms Renate Voskuijlen, home address in Utrecht region.
Machine: Brevano Aria Duo, serial BH-6-24118093.
Proof of purchase: invoice no. KD-2024-778120 from Kaffeehaus Direkt GmbH, dated 10 August 2024, price EUR 749.00, paid by card. Delivery note: delivered 10 August 2024 (collected in shop).
Registration: recorded in the Brevano system on 22 September 2024 (via phone). Customer note on the registration: "Tried online in August several times, the site kept failing."
Customer profile: the registration form lists the address both as home address and as the business address of "RV Vertalingen" (sole-trader translation business run from the customer's home study; no employees).
Previous service: none.

DOCUMENT 5 — SERVICE ORDER SO-26-118374
Opened: 2 September 2026, by phone.
Customer description: "Machine powers on, lights normal, but no water comes through the group. Pump hums very loudly for a second and then stops. Started last week."
Machine received at service centre: 9 September 2026.
Technician report (T. Haverkamp, 11 September 2026):
- Descaling log (read from the machine's memory): descaled every 6–8 weeks as recommended; last descaling 14 August 2026.
- Light scale in the brew group; not causal.
- Pump motor winding open circuit; pump seized. Defect in materials (winding insulation breakdown). Not caused by scale, misuse or voltage.
- Repair: replace pump with P-4410-B. Parts retail price EUR 62.00. Labour: pump replacement.
- Other findings: group gasket worn (wear item) — recommended replacement at customer's cost EUR 9.50; customer declined.
- Repair is technically possible; estimated total repair cost well below 70% of the current retail price of an equivalent machine (EUR 799).
Front-desk note (J. Olde, 11 September 2026): "Purchased Aug 2024, so it's over 24 months. Registration was 43 days after purchase — outside the 30 days. Looks like no coverage; also the customer has a business registered at that address. Suggest sending a full paid-repair quote."
Customer email (12 September 2026): "I use the machine only at home — two coffees a day, I don't sell anything. My translation business is just me at my desk. Please let me know what the repair will cost."
Parts availability: P-4410-B in stock (warehouse Venlo, 140 units). Estimated turnaround after quote acceptance: 3 business days, then return shipment.
Loan machine: not requested by the customer.

decision.instructions: Determine the warranty outcome for the pump failure in service order SO-26-118374 under WB-HOME-22 and the service bulletins.

criteria.full_repair_no_charge: The defect is within standard coverage: Parts and Labour are free.
criteria.not_covered: No warranty coverage applies; the customer pays for Parts and Labour.
criteria.parts_covered_labour_charged: The defect is within extended parts coverage: the pump is supplied free, but Labour is charged at the flat rate.
criteria.pro_rata_replacement_credit: The machine is to be replaced by a pro-rated replacement credit under 3.4.
